تفتقدي (form VIII)
# تَفْتَقِدِي (taftaqidī) /taf.ta.qi.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# تُفْتَقَدِي (tuftaqadī) /tuf.ta.qa.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
